## Problem or user story

Who has the problem, how often does it occur, and what observable outcome should improve?

## Change

Which skill was created or improved, and what non-obvious HireData or industry knowledge does it add?

## Evidence

| Eval case | Baseline score | Candidate score | Reviewer |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Normal | | | |
| Missing or ambiguous data | | | |
| Safety or invalid input | | | |

Link the anonymized outputs, tool traces, and reviewer notes. Explain any regression or trade-off.

## Checklist

- [ ] Connected to an observed problem, user story, or recurring task.
- [ ] Uses the HireData MCP as the source of truth where available.
- [ ] Contains no customer data, credentials, or confidential information.
- [ ] Adds or updates normal, ambiguous, and safety regression cases.
- [ ] Compares the previous/no-skill baseline with the candidate in fresh contexts.
- [ ] Introduces no critical safety, privacy, or invented-tool-result failure.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_repo.py` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and installation guidance remain accurate.
